name: music-transfer-self-serve
description: Self-hosted web tool for one-time additive transfers between Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music
author: Shreyas (@shreyasdbz)

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspace @mtss/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspace @mtss/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspace @mtss/server && npm run build --workspace @mtss/web
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @mtss/server && npm test --workspace @mtss/design-tokens && npm run typecheck --workspace @mtss/web
